_comment: Scoped under the @deph org because npm rejects the unscoped deph-cli as too similar to del-cli, and `deph` itself is taken by an unrelated package. The binary is still `deph`. PyPI uses the unscoped deph-cli, which is free there.
name: @deph/cli
description: Audit npm, pip and cargo dependencies for vulnerabilities, outdated versions and disallowed licenses, against a policy file in your repo.
author: Faisal Khalil Sayyed
